## NBA buzz: Latest on trades, news, roster moves and intel

The league calendar never stops, and neither does the flow of information around it. ESPN's stable of insiders continues to track the latest developments across all 30 franchises, from front-office maneuvering to locker-room whispers. Whether it's a surprise roster addition, a late-breaking trade discussion, or intel on how teams are shaping up ahead of the next tip-off, this is the central hub for everything breaking in real time. Bookmark it if you want to stay current—the NBA doesn't wait for anyone, and the news cycle certainly won't either.

## 2026 NBA free agency: Grades for offseason signings, extensions

The ink is drying on another summer of dealmaking, and ESPN is handing out report cards. Among the moves under the microscope: Cason Wallace's $139 million extension with the Thunder, a significant financial commitment to a young guard Oklahoma City clearly views as part of its long-term core. The grading process weighs not just the dollar figures but the fit, the timing, and the opportunity cost for each franchise. Some teams nailed their offseason priorities; others may have overpaid or missed the mark entirely. It's the kind of retroactive analysis that shapes how we understand team-building in a cap-constrained league.

## Ugonna Onyenso thought his NBA dream was over -- then the Detroit Pistons called him up

Ugonna Onyenso heard his name called 53rd at the 2026 NBA Draft, a moment he once thought would never come. The Detroit Pistons center had already written off his chances of reaching the league, convinced the dream had slipped away for good. Now he's tasked with an entirely different challenge: filling the considerable void left by Isaiah Stewart. Onyenso is confident he can grow into those sizable shoes, a belief born not from bravado but from the knowledge that he's already defied his own expectations once. It's a classic draft-night redemption story, and Detroit is betting he has more chapters left to write.
